name: Jivantyadi Kashayam

sections.reference_sahasrayogam_kashaya_yoga_prak: Jivantyadi Kashayam is an Ayurvedic medicine in herbal decoction form. It is mainly used in the treatment of fever with eruptions. This medicine is formulated based on Kerala Ayurveda principles.
sections.ingredients:
Jivanti – Leptadenia reticulata 
 Hrivera – Pavonia odorata 
 Triphala – (Amla – Emblica officinalis , Haritaki – Terminalia chebula and Vibhitaki – Terminalia bellirica) 
 Vasa – Adhatoda vasica 
 Giloy – Tinospora cordifolia 
 Sariva – Hemidesmus indicus 
 Ginger – Zingiber officinalis 
 Mulethi- Glycyrrhiza glabra 
 Musta- Cyperus rotundus 
 Chandana – Pterocarpus santalinus 
 Patola – Trichosanthes lobata 
 Ushira – Vetiveria zizanioides 
 Neem – Azadirachta indica 

 Method of Preparation 
 All the above mentioned ingredients are added with 8 parts of water. It is boiled until reduced to quarter part. Jivantyadi Kashayam is prepared. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Jivantyadi Kashayam is an Ayurvedic medicine, available in the herbal decoction form. It is primarily used to manage the Chickenpox. It is also an effective medicine to manage the fever with eruptions. Herbs used in the formulation of this medicine are packed with antimicrobial, blood purification, anti-inflammatory and healing properties which help to manage the various infections. Use of this medicine is quite effective to manage the symptoms associated with the chickenpox like fever, malaise, red spots, blisters, and crusted lesions. This medicine helps to boost up the immune system and increases the body’s ability to fight against the viral, bacterial and fungal infections. In the case of genital herpes, anti-inflammatory and analgesic actions of this medicine is quite helpful to provide relief in the cold sores. This medicine also works well in scabies and itches. Antiseptic action of this medicine is quite good to heal the boils in diabetes.
sections.dosage:
10 – 20 ml, before food or on empty stomach, once or twice a day, or as directed by Ayurvedic physician. 
 It is usually administered along with honey and jaggery.
sections.indications: Mainly used in the treatment of fever due to eruptions and Chickenpox.
sections.side_effects:
For diabetic patients, take this medicine with special care as it may lower blood glucose level. 
 This medicine under strict medical supervision for children, pregnant and lactating mothers. 
 Store in a dry cool place. 
 Keep out of reach and sight of children. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Jivantyadi Kashayam 
 Reference: Sahasrayogam, Kashaya Yoga Prakarana – Masurikahara Kashaya 1. 
 Jivantyadi Kashayam is an Ayurvedic medicine in herbal decoction form. It is mainly used in the treatment of fever with eruptions. This medicine is formulated based on Kerala Ayurveda principles. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Jivanti – Leptadenia reticulata 
 Hrivera – Pavonia odorata 
 Triphala – (Amla – Emblica officinalis , Haritaki – Terminalia chebula and Vibhitaki – Terminalia bellirica) 
 Vasa – Adhatoda vasica 
 Giloy – Tinospora cordifolia 
 Sariva – Hemidesmus indicus 
 Ginger – Zingiber officinalis 
 Mulethi- Glycyrrhiza glabra 
 Musta- Cyperus rotundus 
 Chandana – Pterocarpus santalinus 
 Patola – Trichosanthes lobata 
 Ushira – Vetiveria zizanioides 
 Neem – Azadirachta indica 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 All the above mentioned ingredients are added with 8 parts of water. It is boiled until reduced to quarter part. Jivantyadi Kashayam is prepared. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Jivantyadi Kashayam is an Ayurvedic medicine, available in the herbal decoction form. It is primarily used to manage the Chickenpox. It is also an effective medicine to manage the fever with eruptions. Herbs used in the formulation of this medicine are packed with antimicrobial, blood purification, anti-inflammatory and healing properties which help to manage the various infections. Use of this medicine is quite effective to manage the symptoms associated with the chickenpox like fever, malaise, red spots, blisters, and crusted lesions. This medicine helps to boost up the immune system and increases the body’s ability to fight against the viral, bacterial and fungal infections. In the case of genital herpes, anti-inflammatory and analgesic actions of this medicine is quite helpful to provide relief in the cold sores. This medicine also works well in scabies and itches. Antiseptic action of this medicine is quite good to heal the boils in diabetes. 
 Dosage 
 
 10 – 20 ml, before food or on empty stomach, once or twice a day, or as directed by Ayurvedic physician. 
 It is usually administered along with honey and jaggery. 
 
 Indications 
 
 Mainly used in the treatment of fever due to eruptions and Chickenpox. 
 Effective in ordinary boils and diabetic carbuncles. 
 Herpes, scabies and itches. 
 
 Side Effects 
 
 For diabetic patients, take this medicine with special care as it may lower blood glucose level. 
 This medicine under strict medical supervision for children, pregnant and lactating mothers. 
 Store in a dry cool place. 
 Keep out of reach and sight of children. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
